title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under varying policies, supply conditions, prices, and social influence.

interactions.name: peer_influence_contagion
interactions.description: Mask adoption spreads via social influence: individuals update beliefs and adoption based on neighbors’ behaviors and attitudes.

interactions.name: household_norm_influence
interactions.description: Household norms and shared stocks affect individual adoption and adherence.

interactions.name: purchase_masks
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers, constrained by inventory, price, and rationing.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_locations
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; persons may comply, be denied entry, warned, or fined via authority mechanisms.

interactions.name: information_campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Authorities and media broadcast messages that update individuals’ risk perception and perceived benefits/costs.

interactions.name: supply_shock_to_retailers
interactions.description: Exogenous shocks alter retailer restocking and available inventory, affecting availability and price.

interactions.name: sanctioning_and_fines
interactions.description: Noncompliance in mandated contexts can lead to warnings or fines, influencing future adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks (or adopting consistent use) at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: contextual_compliance
metrics.description: Average compliance rate within locations where masks are required versus recommended or optional.

metrics.name: purchase_coverage
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals with adequate mask supply relative to their usage needs.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across income or risk groups (e.g., Gini coefficient).

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_per_day
metrics.description: Counts of warnings and fines issued per day.

metrics.name: price_elasticity_of_adoption
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate per unit change in mask price.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Frequency and duration of retailer stockouts for each mask type.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds_check
validation_criteria.description: Ensure adoption and compliance rates remain within [0,1] at all times.

validation_criteria.name: inventory_nonnegative
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventories must never become negative; transactions fail when inventory is insufficient.

validation_criteria.name: no_influence_sanity
validation_criteria.description: With social influence, information campaign effectiveness, and enforcement all set to zero, adoption should remain near the initial level absent exogenous shocks.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_under_stable_policy
validation_criteria.description: Under stable policies and parameters, the adoption trajectory’s day-over-day change should fall below a small epsilon over a trailing window (e.g., last 14 days).
